text:
zoe: Quick ask \/ we need a one-page "Decision Quickcard" (PDF + single-line landing snippet) for deploy modes: Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Audience: SDRs -> AE handoff and webinar signup tile. Keep it ultra-scannable.

fletcher: Agreed. Sections: 2-line value prop, a 3-cell decision strip (when to pick each), two micro-benchmark tiles (latency | cost), security bullet list, tiny engineer checklist, CTA. Also prep a compliance-focused variant.

mei: Benchmarks for marketing callouts: p50 gen latency ~78ms (Dedicated, 512 ctx), p95 tail under burst ~330ms (Hosted). Embedding latency ~17ms. Cost callouts: Hosted baseline ~$0.21 /1k tokens; optimized stack (Dedicated + quant + batching) ~$0.037 /1k tokens. Add footnote: numbers vary by workload.

zoe: Love it. Webinar hooks: "Stop inference surprises with the right deploy mode" and "SLA & cost clarity for production LLMs". Landing snippet needs headline, 3 takeaways, two benchmark tiles, CTA. Two micro-variants: General + Compliance (swap top bullets).

fletcher: For inbound routing we want deterministic rules so security/compliance leads go straight to field. Draft HubSpot rules (simple):

```
- tag=security_high if body contains: FedRAMP OR SOC2 OR HIPAA OR PCI
- tag=private_interest if body contains: on-prem OR "air-gapped" OR VPC OR "no-cloud"
- set=enterprise_signal if ARR_est >= 100000 OR company_size >= 1500
- route_to=AE_queue if tag=security_high OR tag=private_interest OR enterprise_signal==true
- fallback=SDR_queue
- webhook: POST lead+transcript to /eng-solutions for security_high
```

routing-bot: rules staged (rs-2030-02-18-01). Smoke-tests: 8\/8 passed.

mei: Copy microtiles like this: left tile = "p50 gen latency ~78ms (Dedicated)"; right tile = "Per-1k token cost: ~$0.037 (Optimized)" with footnote: "approx; depends on prompt length & batch strategy". Add a one-line ops quote: "Dedicated stabilized our tails and invoices"  -Pilot: Arbor Health.

zoe: Engineer quickbox (3 bullets): sample prompt used (chat 64 tokens), expected latency band (Dedicated p50 50-100ms; Hosted p95 up to ~330ms), tuning knobs (batch size, KV cache, quant), recommended model family. Also include rollback note: automatic model-variant fallback + canary.

fletcher: Messaging iteration plan: publish both landing variants, 50/50 A\/B for two weeks, measure CTA -> SQL conversion. If compliance variant lifts AE handoffs, keep it.

zoe: Timeline: draft PDF + HTML snippet by Thu EOD, routing already staged. @mei please add confidence ranges next to the bench tiles. I'll post draft link when ready and schedule a 20-min review Fri 9:30am PT.

mei: Will add footnotes and confidence ranges. Draft link coming in 1hr.

fletcher: Thanks team \/ once draft is up we'll tag sales, solutions, and legal for a quick read. :thumbsup:
